axe_description: Ensure all page content is contained by landmarks
axe_help: All page content should be contained by landmarks
failure_summary:
Fix any of the following:

finding_title: Content is not contained within a landmark region
why_it_matters: Landmarks can help assistive-technology users navigate major areas of a page efficiently.
recommendation: Review whether the content belongs inside an appropriate semantic landmark such as <main>, <nav>, <header>, <footer>, or another labelled region.
manual_review_reason: Adding landmarks blindly can create excessive or incorrect landmark structure.

axe_description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
axe_help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
failure_summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has a 1:1 contrast ratio with the background
finding_title: Text color contrast requires review
why_it_matters: Insufficient contrast between text and its background can make content difficult to read for users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies.
recommendation: Check the computed foreground and background colors of the affected text. Normal-sized text should generally have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, while qualifying large text should generally have a ratio of at least 3:1.
manual_review_reason: axe returned this finding as incomplete when contrast could not be conclusively evaluated automatically. Background images, gradients, transparency, overlapping elements, or other rendered styling can require manual inspection.
location_note: DOM selector: .on | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable
